thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for svc/inference-compiler (pd:PD12345) — sustained 502 rate > 8% over 5m in us-west. Auto-escalation to Triage. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerbot: Auto-ack by oliver (on-call). Claim window started.

oliver: ACK. i'm seeing the PD alert, on my way to triage. any initial notes?

maria: heads up — customers reporting downstream errors in the /generate endpoint, not just internal tests. I can take this if oliver needs to swap.

oliver: if you're available pls take it, i'm finishing a stash. swapping to you now.

maria: taking it. quick status: control-plane shows a spike of model compile errors coming from the JIT step after the recent kernel rollforward (rollout 2026-03-15). compiling fails with OOM/INVALID for a subset of requests.

raj: looking at logs — we have repeated entries like:
```
ERROR kernel_compile failed: failed to allocate 0x2000000 bytes, reason: out_of_memory
trace: /srv/runtime/compiler/compile.cpp:342
request_id=8a3f... user=internal-synth
```

maria: thanks. that OOM makes sense; some model variants got a new op kernel that inflates memory. mitigation idea: route traffic away from the new variant to the stable v1.

devon: we have routing feature flags. can we flip traffic back to model-stable-1 in us-west only?

maria: yes. running quick command (will prep rollback and sanity check):
```bash
# rollback routing for us-west only
redwoodctl route update inference-service --region us-west --model model-stable-1 --weight 100
```

srebot: NOTE: modifying routes will cause short burst of requests to fail if downstream caches are primed; plan is safe but expect ~30s of elevated latency.

maria: executing now.

pagerbot: Route update initiated by maria. PD note: manual mitigation in-progress.

maria: done. routes show 100% model-stable-1 in us-west. watching metrics.

oliver: nice. any immediate reduction on 502s?

raj: checking metrics — 502s dropping from 9% -> 1.2% over last 90s. error logs for compile failures have ceased.

support-jen: customer comms note: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, brightside) had elevated errors; CS is prepping a heads-up. please add impact summary when we have stable numbers.

maria: agreed — initial impact window ~ 12:02 UTC -> 12:12 UTC, approx 10 minutes. I'll capture telemetry and draft brief.

devon: can we prevent auto-rolls landing on production without canarying next time? Is rollout policy set to 10% canary?

raj: it was set to 10% but due to a tagging mismatch the variant ended up in 100% of an AZ. root cause: rollout tag mismatch. opening a PR to tighten gating.

maria: as immediate follow-up: create rollback hotfix (patched rollout config) and schedule re-deploy for midnight. assign action items:
- raj: PR for gating + stricter tag checks (owner)
- devon: add an automated smoke test to verify compile step in staging before canary
- oliver: run a retro with infra/config team tomorrow

oliver: acked for retro.

pagerbot: PD update: acknowledged by maria. severity downgraded to SEV2 by srebot after mitigation shows recovery.

srebot: SEV2 assigned. No ongoing customer outages. monitoring for 30m.

maria: drafting customer impact note: "Between 12:02–12:12 UTC some requests to /generate in us-west returned 502s due to a model compile memory regression after a kernel rollout. We rolled back routing to model-stable-1 and errors subsided. No data loss. We're hardening rollout checks and adding smoke tests." anyone want to edit?

support-jen: looks good, pls include affected customers list and exact percent error peak. I'll send to CS once you paste numbers.

raj: peak 502 rate 9.8% (12:04 UTC), total affected requests ~3.2k in us-west.

maria: pasted final note to PD and CS. moving to watch state. handoff: taking ownership for postmortem; i'll coordinate with raj/devon. If no regressions in 30m, we'll resolve PD.

oliver: thanks for the handoff. ping me if you need more infra access. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD incident PD12345 set to watch. last updated by maria.

maria: closing loop — no other regions impacted. marking action items in the runbook and assigning PRs. will post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems after initial investigation.

support-jen: CS notified, customers acknowledged.

maria: resolving PD in 25m if stable. thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
